caption: The video captures a fixed dawn landscape where a calm lake fills the foreground and snow-dusted peaks line the horizon, reflected in the mostly still water. A horizontal band of low mist hovers over the surface, continuously reshaping as wisps thin and thicken near the shoreline and the mountain bases. A forested shore sits on the right and a dark hill on the left, holding their positions while the camera stays steady. A small bright point appears in the misty mid-ground on the left and drifts gradually rightward toward the centre before fading. Faint linear ripples disturb the left foreground water at intervals, spreading briefly then settling while the mountain reflection stays largely intact. The pale blue sky above the peaks remains essentially unchanged, with a tiny bright dot moving across the upper sky. The framing remains steady, keeping the mirrored peaks and drifting mist as dominant elements. The clip thus presents an ongoing, quiet reshaping of mist and surface rather than a single completed action.
relations: Low mist band over the lake surface reshapes as wisps thin and thicken near the shoreline and mountain bases.
A bright point emerging in the left misty mid-ground drifts gradually rightward toward the centre before fading out.
Faint linear ripples disturbing the left foreground water spread briefly then settle, keeping the mountain reflection largely intact.
A tiny bright dot moving across the upper pale blue sky persists while the overall sky remains unchanged.
